summary: Erzurum International Airport (ERZ/LTCE) is a medium-sized airport serving Erzurum in eastern Turkey, located about 5 km from the city center. Situated at roughly 1,756 m elevation, it is the main gateway to the Palandöken ski resort and eastern Anatolia. It operates domestic flights year-round and seasonal international services, with a modern terminal and a long runway suited to winter conditions.
faqs:
Q: How far is Erzurum Airport from the city center?
A: It is about 5-6 km from central Erzurum, typically a 10-15 minute taxi or shuttle ride.

Q: Which airlines operate at Erzurum Airport?
A: Turkish Airlines, AJet, Pegasus Airlines, and other carriers operate domestic flights; international service is mainly seasonal.

Q: Is there public transport from the airport to Erzurum?
A: Yes, shuttle services and municipal buses connect the airport with the city center, though schedules can be limited outside peak hours.

Q: Does Erzurum Airport serve Palandöken ski resort?
A: Yes, it is the closest major airport to Palandöken, about 15-20 km away, with taxis and pre-booked transfers available.
transport_tips: The airport is only about 5 km from central Erzurum, so taxis are quick and relatively inexpensive. Shuttle services and city buses also run to the center, but confirm times for early or late flights. If heading to Palandöken, pre-book a transfer or taxi, especially during ski season when demand is high.
local_tip: On clear days, sit on the left side when arriving from Istanbul or Ankara for views of the Palandöken Mountains; in winter, keep ski gear accessible for quick transfer loading.
